description: Extend the Web TaskLogPanel with client-only keyword search, data-driven source-chip filtering, filtered-view text download, scroll-aware auto-follow, and deterministic boundary states — mirroring the system LogsPage interaction pattern without sharing code. No backend changes.

tasks.title: Task log panel viewing enhancement: search, source filter, download, auto-follow, boundary states
tasks.description: Extend packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/TaskLogPanel.tsx with: (1) a case-insensitive substring search input over text+source; (2) data-driven source-chip filters derived as the distinct source set from loaded lines, using an opt-out disabledSources: Set<string> state (empty = all visible, the sole filter dimension — no level); (3) a single compositional useMemo over [lines, disabledSources, searchQuery] applying AND semantics, consumed by both rendering and download so export is WYSIWYG; (4) a download button exporting the filtered view as a .txt via a client Blob + temporary <a download> with filename task-logs-<taskId>-YYYY-MM-DD.txt, disabled when filtered is empty; (5) scroll-aware auto-follow (userPausedAutoFollow flag driven by a scroll handler, follow effect keyed on filtered.length) replacing the current always-scroll-to-bottom; (6) deterministic boundary-state branches (loading / error / empty log / no-search-match / no-source-match with search message winning). Use neutral slate chip styling (NOT LEVEL_CHIP_COLORS), mirror LogsPage's Tailwind class strings for visual parity without sharing logic. Keep all Phase 1/2 subscription/merge/invalidation logic intact. Add functional cases to TaskLogPanel.test.tsx (typing narrows, chip toggle hides, AND composition, download reflects filter + filename + no network, three boundary messages, default shows all, scroll-pause does not force-scroll, live-append non-regression) and a new packages/web/tests/a11y/task-log-a11y.test.tsx under the separate a11y vitest config covering search input, each source chip, and download button (keyboard reachability + structural axe rules), following settings-a11y.test.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing a keyword into the search input narrows visible lines in real time to those whose text OR source contains the term (case-insensitive), with no new network request (verify via React Query cache only).

Exactly one chip is rendered per distinct source present in the loaded lines (data-driven, not a fixed enum); no chip renders for an absent source. Sources render in lexicographic order for deterministic output.
Toggling a source chip off hides all lines of that source while leaving other sources visible; a newly-arrived source from live append remains visible by default (opt-out disabledSources semantics).
No control keyed on error/warning/info severity exists; chips use a neutral slate palette, not LEVEL_CHIP_COLORS.
A line is visible only if it passes BOTH the search term AND the enabled source chips (AND composition via a single useMemo).

Clicking download produces a .txt Blob containing exactly the currently filtered lines (text per line, seq order) with filename matching task-logs-<taskId>-YYYY-MM-DD.txt; hidden lines are excluded; with no filter active the file equals the whole loaded log; the button is disabled when the filtered set is empty; no HTTP request is triggered.
Default state on open: search box empty, all source chips enabled, every loaded line visible.

Scroll-aware auto-follow: scrolling away from the bottom pauses auto-follow (new/filtered lines do not yank the viewport); scrolling back near the bottom resumes it. The follow effect keys on filtered.length.

Boundary states render distinct messages in deterministic priority: loading -> 'Loading execution log…'; error -> 'Execution log unavailable'; zero loaded lines -> empty-log message (data-testid='task-log-empty' preserved); non-empty with zero filtered and non-empty search -> no-search-match message; non-empty with zero filtered and all sources disabled -> no-source-filter message. When both search and source filters yield no rows, the search message wins.

Phase 1/2 non-regression: line-by-line rendering (timestamp, source, text), truncation indicator, running-state SignalR subscription, live delta append, and terminal-state cache invalidation behave exactly as before; existing TaskLogPanel.test.tsx assertions still pass.

Search input has a label (visible or aria-label), each source chip is a <button> whose accessible name is the source string, and the download button has a discernible accessible name; all are keyboard-reachable in tab order.
packages/web/tests/a11y/task-log-a11y.test.tsx passes the same structural axe rules used across the app under the separate a11y vitest config (excluded from default npm test).
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes; npm run test:run -w packages/web passes; the a11y suite passes green.
tasks.output: Modified packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/TaskLogPanel.tsx (search input, source-chip bar, download button, compositional useMemo, scroll-aware auto-follow, boundary states), extended packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/TaskLogPanel.test.tsx, and new packages/web/tests/a11y/task-log-a11y.test.tsx. typecheck + default web tests + a11y suite all green.
tasks.notes: Follow design.md decisions D1–D10 strictly. D1: inline all logic into TaskLogPanel.tsx, no new modules/hooks. D2: mirror LogsPage pattern, do NOT share code (different line models and filter dimensions). D4: disabledSources opt-out Set (NOT enabledSources opt-in) because sources are data-driven and grow during live append. D5: single compositional useMemo consumed by both render and download. D6: download exports the FILTERED view (WYSIWYG). D7: follow effect keys on filtered.length. D8: boundary priority search > source. Reference primitives in packages/web/src/pages/logs/ui/LogsPage.tsx (search useMemo, Set-based chips, Blob export, scroll-aware follow) for pattern, and packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/TaskLogPanel.test.tsx buildHarness + fake SignalR for test harness. No changes to server, runner, REST endpoint, SignalR channel, TaskLogLine wire type, or any store.
